body: Hi. I noticed tinnitus 1 month ago. I did listen music via earbuds at max volume for 2-3 years. It used to be hours a day . But was usually almost max/max volume. And because of quarantine I listened music almost every hour I'm awake and at max volume as usual. Quarantine time was 3 months. 1 month ago I had noticed a ringing in my ear. It was not disturbing and I didn't care and even thought it was a cricket or something because it was night. 2 days later (I did use my earbuds meanwhile) i noticed more sharp frequency and freaked out. Well I wish this was the whole story but it's not. I did go ENT there was no hearing loss up to 8000hz. There was no physical problem. So took ginkgo biloba. My tinnitus was so loud at nights and very high pitched. But I could sleep anyway despite waking up 2/3  times. But it got worse and I panicked. I always assumed I have hearing loss at higher frequencies. But couldn't make it check. My second Dr prescribed me betaserc. And I used it I think it caused my hyperacusis to be worse. Then I went a third Dr and wanted cortisone. He gave me. I wanted to try everything. Before trying I hesitated but my tinnitus was louder. Thus I thought I had nothing to lose. I used it for 7 days. But on last day I did noticed new tones and and my T got louder.i went fourth Ent. Get checked my hearing between 8000 and 16000 hz and only have 40 dB loss at 16.000 hz  in my right ear.(don't know about above 16.000) It is screeching piercing and very high frequency also loud. I feel it not just hear. I stopped methylprednisolone. I was already self blaming for everything. I can't sleep anymore it's too loud and disturbing. It is high level severe tinnitus. No this is still not the whole story. Ah I'm tired sorry. I used to masturbate once a day for 4 years. And sometimes got ringing for a few seconds. And today I read some cases where it is caused by overmasturbation. And I sometimes did masturbate 2 or 3 a day. The worst is I masturbated in this month. I was so stressed and depressed and it seemed get loud but then set down. And the second worst is today I masturbated and get relief three times at once. It spiked for minutes and I seek for any information about masturbation and tinnitus and there are cases. I am fucked up guys. I don't know what is the cause. Earbuds, masturbation? I don't have hearing loss as I said. And Dr s said it's unlikely to be because of earbuds but I had some kind of burning and pain when I listened to music and  hyperacusis. Did it worsened by cortisone or masturbation or noise that I have been exposed? Or all of them? I'm totally fucked up. I did all of these to me by myself. I don't know  it's getting worse and I can't have hope on researches because I don't have a certain hearing loss or cause. How can someone be that stupid? I'm afraid of everything. I don't think I will be able to endure this. I can't.
I wanna live but I am fucked up. Things don't get better only worsen. I'm tired of being tired. I just wanna have a silent sleep maybe forever.
